analysis_contract: All40labels/all5seeds/3matched-input-budgetheads; both validation-selected and test; no sorting/exclusion for inferential claims, no p-values, heldout reports already exposed.
limits: Validation used for epoch selection, test already exposed; seed consistency is hypothesis generation only.
Confusion aggregates do not identify paired per-example errors, hidden states, calibration or causal mechanisms.
Head parameter counts differ, despite common input/training/value-decoder initialization.
Absent/rare label support limits interpretation; full40 denominator unchanged.
No novel method or L5 follows from class-pattern selection.

review.observed_bottleneck: Across all three heads, five seeds and both splits, positive-to-null errors exceed wrong-positive errors. Mean within-cell shares of positive errors assigned to null range from 76.2% to 79.1% across head/split combinations. This is a shared error pattern, not evidence of a quantum-specific bottleneck or its cause.
causes_unidentified: Effects of unequal head parameter counts
review.next_question: For each of the 30 frozen head/seed/split cells, is the gold relation the unique highest-scoring non-null label on more than half of positive examples currently predicted as null, when evaluated using the original decision scores without retraining, threshold sweeps or tuning?
required_observables: Per-example gold labels and original predictions for the existing selected-validation and exposed-test examples.
Original inference-time scores for all labels from each frozen selected checkpoint, including the exact decision rule and tie handling.
For each cell, the positive-to-null denominator and counts where the gold label ranks uniquely first, ties for first, or ranks below first among non-null labels.
review.falsification: The bounded hypothesis that a majority of null misses retain correct unique top-positive ranking in every cell is falsified if any cell has a unique-top-gold fraction at or below 50%. Higher fractions show retained positive ranking on those examples; lower fractions show that removing null alone would not recover most misses. Neither result identifies calibration, attention or a causal mechanism.
risks: Required per-example scores are absent from the compact report; aggregates cannot answer this question.
Gold-conditioned null exclusion is an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable decision rule or estimated utility gain.
Selected validation and exposed test support descriptive diagnosis, not fresh confirmation.
Correct non-null ranking does not establish calibration or explain why null won.
No execution, architecture change, novelty claim or literature clearance is authorized.
